title: docs(adr): ADR-0150 records its children's rulings; ADR-0048 §5, ADR-0129 and ADR-0130 point at it (ADR-0150 child A)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbRSEASPFQojyg3PhVYDG2Jp)_

Fixes #31685

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改文档（四份 ADR 和一处代码注释，不改代码）。ADR-0150 补记子卡上已裁定、或由专题席位记录的七条：闭包外的包被拒绝（含同一发布包里没声明依赖的兄弟包）、阶段一之前就重名的部署被拒绝、同对象同名动作被拒绝（落在动作收尾卡）、`base`/`system`/`sys` 不受同命名空间唯一规则约束、扩展目标和 everyone/guest 锚点按无包调用方解析、无归属的引擎函数算平台持有者。ADR-0048 §5 的 lint 条目改成现状；ADR-0129、ADR-0130 加带日期的交叉引用。
- 为什么改：这些裁决都已在子卡上定下并有记录，但 ADR-0150 正文还写着旧说法（比如「阶段一覆盖的类型不会有两个持有者」「动作已被阶段一兜底」）；P 合入后 ADR-0048 §5 还说 lint 对所有裸名告警、阶段三会改成拒绝。不改的话，后续子卡会照着过时的正文去做。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字，无运行时风险，不发版（`skip-changeset`）。回滚即撤销这一个提交。
- 先看：ADR-0150 D3 新增的 (c) 段和「Covered and uncovered types」段；ADR-0048 §5 第一个条目；ADR-0130 D1 下的注记。
- 两分钟验证：运行 `pnpm check:adr-index && node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`，两条都应退出 0。
- 需要你做的：契约复审通过后，审阅并合并（Tier H，`docs/adr/**`）。

## What changes

Docs only: four ADRs and one code comment. No code, schema, lint or skills change.

- **ADR-0150** (status line gains an **Amended** entry). Each sentence cites the record it writes in:
  - **D3 (c)**: a package caller never resolves to a package outside its declared closure by bare name. This is step 3 of the ruled rule (6723462584), recorded as such by the epic seat (6728487836). A sibling package of the same release artifact is no exception unless declared (N1, ruled A, 6729820123), with the severity that record gives.
  - **D3, caller-less references**: a picklist extension's target (epic-seat ruling X, 6728613177) and the audience anchors `everyone` and `guest` (an epic-seat reading recorded in its E3 review, 6732998040 on draft PR #31815) resolve as a caller with no package.
  - **D2**: the shareable namespaces `base`, `system` and `sys` are not judged by child N's co-owner rule (epic red-line review of N, 6728571147 on PR #31717); a qualified address there answers `409` with the candidates, and G1 pins it.
  - **D4**: an owner-less engine function registration is the platform's holder, reachable from every closure like `sys` (R2 review 6729484996 item 2, refined by re-review 6730444942 item 1).
  - **Execution plan, covered types**: the object-less action is what phase 1 covers. Two cases keep two package holders even so: a clash sealed before phase 1 (#31677 Q1 ruled A, 6729831159) and a same-object same-name action pair (#31697 ruled A, 6729825528). The sentence "no two package holders of a name exist while its refusal stands" is narrowed accordingly.
  - **Execution plan, releasability**: the "except D3 (a)" sentence now also names D3 (c).
  - **TL;DR 7**: the three ruled refusals above join the list; "Measured first-party, none of them refuses anything" becomes "Where measured first-party, ...".
- **ADR-0048**:
  - §5's `[done]` authoring-lint bullet is rewritten in place, as d5106ae0 did for the same bullet. It now describes what `naming/namespace-prefix` reports since child P (#31765): the duplicate finding (`DUPLICATE_KEYED_TYPES`), and the bare-name finding for capabilities and positions only (`PREFIX_JUDGED_COLLECTIONS`). Phase 3 of ruling C is withdrawn (record 6721941146 on #30806).
  - A dated note under §3.4 says its lint sentence still holds (see Acceptance notes).
  - The status line gains an **Amended** entry.
- **ADR-0129**: a cross-reference to ADR-0150 on the status line, and a dated note under D4. ADR-0028 is re-opened for the behavioural tier only, objects stay under this record, and ruling C's planned amendment of D2 is withdrawn (6721941146).
- **ADR-0130**: one dated note under D1's first paragraph (N1, 6729820123). Co-ownership does not decide how a reference between two packages of one artifact resolves; the sibling allowance narrows to declared dependencies (ADR-0150 D3). The ADR-0130 text itself is not rewritten.
- **`packages/cli/src/utils/picklist-references.ts`**: the module comment at line 42 gains a dated note pointing at ADR-0150 D3 and the ADR-0130 note. Comment only.

## Why

Child A of epic #31527. The epic seat carried seven items into A's ADR-0150 text (comment 6729937614 on #31685), on top of the card's ADR-0048 and ADR-0129 items. Each item was checked against the record it cites before its sentence was written.

## Tests

None: a docs-only change (`skip-changeset`). The one code edit is a comment, so there is no tested behaviour to ablate.

## Acceptance notes

- **Deviation: ADR-0048 §3.4 is noted, not amended.** The card called its lint sentence stale. Measured on `origin/main` 732def59, it is not: the sentence cites the rule for "an author shipping two `page/home` in one package". That duplicate finding still ships (`DUPLICATE_KEYED_TYPES` in `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts`), and ADR-0150 D9 keeps it. So §3.4 gets a dated note saying the sentence holds and pointing at §5, and only §5's bullet is rewritten. The seat agreed to this reading.
- **Deviation: the ADR-0130 note sits under D1.** ADR-0130 has no sentence about resolving picklists or references. The CLI comment at `picklist-references.ts:42` leans on D1's co-ownership claim, so that is the sentence N1 means. The seat agreed to this placement.
- **Status-line pointers:** ADR-0028's and ADR-0048's pointers to ADR-0150 landed with #31586, and they are not duplicated here. ADR-0150's own status line still reads "Proposed (2026-11-08) ... becomes Accepted by the maintainer's merge", and ADR-0048's pointer still says "takes effect when ADR-0150 is accepted". Both are left as written; they are noted here for the seat.
- **`tool`, corrected per contract review F1** (record 6734267031): `tool` joined phase 1's list (#31414; ADR-0048 P1.10), and `BARE_NAME_ONE_HOLDER_TYPES` (`packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts`) lists 13 entries with `tool` last. ADR-0150 now counts 14 covered types (the constant's 13 plus permission sets), 11 uncovered types without `tool`, and 14 B children. The same fix commit (0a18e768) drops the letter from the N1 citation (F2), dates the ADR-0130 note's install-judge reading to E6 #31731 (F3), and scopes the sealed-clash count to E5's measurement (F5).
- **The E3 reading** is cited as an epic-seat reading recorded on draft PR #31815 (6732998040), not as a ruling.

## Verification

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

Measured on commit bfc1d99b (base `origin/main` 732def59); after merging `origin/main` at ca23ce32, none of the five files changed, and `check:adr-index`, `check-adr-links` and `check-adr-anchors` were re-run there: exit 0 each.

- `dispatch-gates`: 56 gates derived for this diff, 56 run, all exit 0. `--ran` reconcile: 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Prerequisite builds under the verify lock: spec + formula + lint prebuild, VERDICT 0; full `turbo run build --filter=./packages/**`, VERDICT 0 (81/81 tasks).
- First pass: 6 gates exited 3 (prerequisites missing, not a measurement): the teardown self-test (pinned fixture commit 621a4876 not fetched in a shallow clone), and dual-build-cjs-loads, i18n, i18n-coverage, i18n-walk-parity and lean-entry-closure (needed built packages). After fetching the commit and running the full build, all six exit 0.
- Body gates with this body as the event payload: check-closing-keyword-parity, check-changeset-no-major, check:adr-0087-registration and check-partof-closing-keyword, exit 0 each.
- Diff: 5 files, +106 / -26. The review-fix commit 0a18e768 touches only ADR-0150 and ADR-0130; `check:adr-index`, `check-adr-links` and `check-adr-anchors` were re-run on it: exit 0 each.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (No name added.)
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` scan is CI's run; the only source edit is a comment.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
